title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location: RemoteType: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:RemoteType:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with\ "agentic\" workflows, turningcomplex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Frontend-Aligned Design: Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization.

● Information Architecture: Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable.

● AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration): Design the\ "Human-in-the-Loop\" patternsfor our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.

Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma, including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and\ "developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI\ "thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.

What We're Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication

description:

We are seeking a UX / Senior Product Designer to define the user experience for our AI-powered procurement platforms. You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with\ "agentic\" workflows, turningcomplex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences.

What You Will Do

● Product & Interface Strategy: Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error.

● Systems Thinking: Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem.

● AI-Assisted Design: Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.

Requirements & Tooling

● Design Tools: Mastery of Figma, including advanced prototyping and design system management.

● Frontend Literacy: A deep understanding of React/TypeScript capabilities so your designs are technically feasible and\ "developer-ready.\"

● AI UX Frameworks: Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI\ "thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops).

● Prototyping: Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic.

● Testing: Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.

What We're Looking For

● Experience: Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools.

● Architecture Focus: You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths.

● Collaborative Mindset: You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed.

● Language Requirements: Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communication

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:RemoteType:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Engenheiro Devops (Inglês Fluente)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro Devops (Inglês Fluente) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

- Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

- Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

- Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

- Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas;
implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

- Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

- Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

- Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

- Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

- Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

- Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.

Requisitos:

- Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras;
conhecimento do mercadofinanceiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

- Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

- Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

- Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

- Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

- Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

- Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

- Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

- Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders;
capacidade de trabalharcom fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

- Inglês avançado.

Desejável:

- Experiência com SAFe;
exposição ao GCP.

- Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

- Espanhol.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Devops Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer with basic Golang skills to support a team focused on improving development processes and the product. In this role, you will work closely with a Staff Engineer building with a focus on designing, migrating, implementing, and maintaining the infrastructure and cloud environments that enable these systems to operate reliably and at scale.

Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts, with a strong emphasis on scalability, security, and operational excellence.

You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you'll often act as the bridge between the team and other internal teams, ensuring infrastructure and systems are aligned with internal standards and best practices.

What we're looking for:

● Strong AWS and DevOps experience (infrastructure, deployments, operations, observability)

● Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)

● Experience with containerized environments (Docker, ECS/EKS, etc.)

● Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Lambda and related cloud tooling

● Golang and Bash skills for scripting, automation, and backend support

● Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders

● Strong communication and coordination skills

Nice to have:

● Familiarity with TypeScript or Node.Js

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working towards engineering excellence and helping the team excel. You will collaborate across infrastructure and development teams to deliver impactful solutions.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Site Reliability Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

O DESAFIO:

  • Garantir a disponibilidade, performance e escalabilidade de nossos serviços críticos, com foco em infraestrutura baseada em AWS EC2 (Windows Server e Linux).
  • Desenvolver e implementar ferramentas e processos de automação para monitoramento, provisionamento, gestão de configuração e resolução de incidentes.
  • Identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance e pontos únicos de falha em nossos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a arquitetura e infraestrutura de nossos produtos.
  • Participar ativamente em análises pós-incidente para identificar causas raízes e implementar medidas preventivas.
  • Definir e monitorar SLAs e SLOs para garantir a qualidade dos nossos serviços.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Confiabilidade de Site (SRE) ou função similar.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com AWS EC2, incluindo: Criação, configuração e gerenciamento de instâncias EC2;
    Otimização de performance de instâncias EC2;
    Escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade de instâncias EC2.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com Windows Server, incluindo: Administração de Windows Server;
    Active Directory;
    IIS (Internet Information Services);
    Powershell scripting.
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com sistemas Linux, incluindo: Administração de servidores Linux (ex: CentOS, Ubuntu);

Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.G., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.Desired Qualifications:The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.G., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

description:

ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role;
it's a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA's proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.

What You'll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice's strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation

What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics

This is the ideal next step if you're seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.

By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role Please Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About The Role You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations. This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You'll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil. This is not just a dashboarding role. You'll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads. We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.What You'll Do Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M) Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.) Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governanceWhat We're Looking For Must have (3–5 years of experience): Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS) Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases) Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments) Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively Strong English communication skills (you'll work with global stakeholders daily)Nice to have: Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation) Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Onboarding Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.

We're expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer's first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.

What You'll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact's value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

What We're Looking For:

  • 4+ years in Customer Success, Onboarding or Implementation at a SaaS company
  • Experience with US-based customers
  • Excellent communication and conversational skills, both written and verbal
  • Proficient or native level English (full business fluency)
  • Detail-oriented, process-driven, and highly organized
  • Engaging, personable, and energetic in customer interactions
  • Comfortable working at high volume without losing quality
  • Sales-trained and able to identify business expansion opportunities
  • Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player,
  • Proven track record of meeting and/or exceeding a business expansion quota

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working at a telecom SaaS
  • Experience working with real estate agents or using real estate SaaS tools

️ Why Smarter Contact?

  • USD base compensation
  • 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays
  • High autonomy, fast execution, real impact
  • Professional development benefit
  • Wellness benefit
  • Employment anniversary and birthday gift
  • Quarterly health allowance
  • Remote-first team with a strong performance culture
  • This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor role

Please Don't Apply If:

  • You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment
  • You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams
  • You don't meet the minimum customer success experience
  • No experience working for a SaaS company

Ready to grow with us?

We're looking for a proven Customer Onboarding Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Loyalty Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?

About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.

What You'll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role.
  • 3+ years within a SaaS company.
  • Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet.
  • Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts.
  • Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure.
  • Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies.
  • Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value.
  • Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player.
  • Proficient or native level English (full business fluency).
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company.
  • Experience working with real estate professionals.

title: Data Annotator - Portuguese
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Annotator - Portuguese em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

About the Role

Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible;
minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor's degree

We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs). This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated content for grammatical, semantic, and contextual accuracy.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mandatory.
  • Native proficiency in German language and the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation, linguistic evaluation, or AI training projects.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Fully remote opportunity, allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives, shaping the future of language technology.

Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

- A collaborative and international work environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering)

Location: Brazil (100% remote)

Contract: PJ – Long Term

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a high-impact team focused on building and scaling systems that power pricing, payments, and merchandising within a luxury resale marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering and product development, supporting both customer-facing applications and internal tools used by operators and business teams.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineering leadership to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performing systems that directly influence key business initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and internal tooling
  • Contribute to user-facing applications that support listing, enrichment, and merchandising workflows
  • Write clean, performant, and testable code in a production environment
  • Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the platform
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering stakeholders
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers
  • Pair program and support team collaboration and onboarding
  • Deploy code to production with a strong focus on reliability and quality
  • Leverage observability tools, metrics, and incident learnings to improve system performance and stability

Tech Stack

Java, Kotlin, Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS (Lambda), PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Experience building production-ready, scalable, and secure systems
  • Solid understanding of backend development and modern web applications
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and common development tools
  • Experience or interest in JVM-based services (Java/Kotlin)
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and streaming systems (e.G., Kafka)
  • Knowledge of database fundamentals and API design (GraphQL or similar)
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to contribute to technical direction and architectural decisions
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with JVM services in production environments
  • Experience with modern frontend technologies (React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS)
  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI APIs into applications or internal tools
  • Experience building microservices and working across distributed systems
  • Background in eCommerce platforms
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms (e.G., Prismic)
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, and incident response

At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.

About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages.

This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.

This is not a translation role. It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.

Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French

What You'll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations

Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Frontend Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we're not just building products, we're pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world's most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that's just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:

  • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
  • Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.

Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter's identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.To or @tether.Io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro De Dados Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!

O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance;
  • Lidar com dadosdistribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;

title: Médico Oncologista Genético
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Oncologista Genético em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital FinanceAt Tether, we're not just building products, we're pioneering a global financial revolution. Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future?About the job As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes: New Products and Features- Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry. Performance- all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Security- Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.Responsibilities Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including: New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies. Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools. Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.Requirements With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend. Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture. Comfortable with high-availability concepts. Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+. Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these. Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools. Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs. Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life. Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels.We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Verify the recruiter's identity.All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods.We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses.All communication from us will come from emails ending   @tether.Io We will never request payment or financial details.If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Médico Oncologista Genético
description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\ "

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.

*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*

  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.
  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.
  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.
  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.
  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.
  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.
  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.
  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.
  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.
  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.
  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.
  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.
  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.
  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.
  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.

Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.

Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.
